invariants.rationale: Parallelism should typically be at least 1 for parallel execution.
The method accesses 'data', which should be non-null for correct operation.
parallelism is an int, so this expression is always true, explicitly specifying its bounds.
It may be reasonable that parallelism should not exceed the input list size, though not strictly enforced by method body.
A Java List's size() is always non-negative.
